summary: Public projects created on 28 July 2026: 2 repos.
intro: Two repositories cover audio preparation and development standards. The first provides Audacity export presets, silence-trimming settings and macros for producing recordings optimised for Whisper or AssemblyAI transcription. The second is research into specification standards for agentic and spec-driven development.

projects.name: Audacity Transcription Presets
projects.description: Export presets, silence-trimming settings and macros for turning an Audacity recording into a file optimised for Whisper/AssemblyAI transcription

projects.name: Spec Standard Research
projects.description: Research into specification standards for agentic / spec-driven development
